description: Mexico Public Broadcasting Transmission Stations is provided by Sistema Publico de Radiodifusion. The Mexican SPR dataset lists public broadcasting transmission stations and their coverage. The page offers separate CSV resources for FM and digital terrestrial television, including call signs, operating frequency where applicable and population coverage. Geographic context: national; Mexico. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: CSV. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. It covers SPR stations, not every broadcaster in Mexico. The portal warns that historical values may change through retroactive updates. Potential simulation use: Build a transmitter inventory and compare public broadcasting service coverage. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnu-radio offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
